item.title: Parsley Health In-Network
item.description:
• Summary: Parsley Health, a holistic primary care provider, announced it is now in-network with major insurance plans nationwide, expanding access to its services. This move is part of a trend of direct-to-consumer healthcare providers integrating with traditional insurance.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Healthcare Organizations Building AI Tools
item.description:
• Summary: Healthcare organizations, including hospitals and insurers, are increasingly developing their own artificial intelligence tools in-house rather than relying solely on vendors. This trend allows for greater customization and data control but requires significant investment.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: AI Diagnosis vs Doctors
item.description:
• Summary: A study comparing AI and doctors in diagnosis found that AI outperformed physicians in certain diagnostic tasks, but the results are nuanced. The article explores the implications for healthcare and the limitations of AI in clinical settings.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT
